column4: Kernel: KeExpandKernelStackAndCallout(CmCreateKeyCallout). Sogen delegates to handle_NtOpenKey first; if that returns STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND it creates the key and writes disposition=1 (REG_CREATED_NEW_KEY); on open returns disposition=2 (REG_OPENED_EXISTING_KEY). Disposition values and handle-writing contract match.
Kernel: CmObReferenceObjectByHandle then CmDeleteKey. Sogen: validates handle in registry_keys store, calls registry.delete_key. STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE on bad handle. Observable contract matches.

Kernel calls CmDeleteValueKey which normally returns STATUS_SUCCESS. Sogen returns STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED because the backing hive is read-only and has no tombstone concept. Sample accepts both ERROR_SUCCESS and ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED. This is a documented conscious limitation rather than a behavioral mismatch — acceptable for a read-only hive model.

Kernel: class>2 → STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER; KeExpandKernelStackAndCallout(CmEnumerateKeyCallout). Sogen: handles KeyBasicInformation(0) and KeyNodeInformation(1); past-end index → STATUS_NO_MORE_ENTRIES; buffer too small → STATUS_BUFFER_OVERFLOW. Observable behavior matches.

Kernel: class>2 → STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER; calls CmpQueryKeyValueData. Sogen: handles KeyValueBasicInformation(0)/Partial(2)/Full(1); past-end → STATUS_NO_MORE_ENTRIES; buffer too small → STATUS_BUFFER_OVERFLOW. Observable behavior matches.

Kernel: thin forwarder — returns NtNotifyChangeMultipleKeys(a1,0,0,a2,...). Sogen: asynchronous→STATUS_PENDING, synchronous→STATUS_SUCCESS. The synchronous path that the sample exercises returns STATUS_SUCCESS. Observable contract matches.
Kernel: one-liner — return NtOpenKeyEx(a1, a2, a3, 0LL). Sogen: handle_NtOpenKey implements the logic directly and handle_NtOpenKeyEx delegates to it. Functionally equivalent delegation.

Kernel: CmpInitializeThreadInfo then KeExpandKernelStackAndCallout(CmOpenKeyCallout). Sogen resolves path through registry store: STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE on bad root directory handle; STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND on absent key; handle written on success. Observable contract matches.

Kernel: class>8 → STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER; calls CmQueryKey. Sogen handles KeyBasicInformation(0)/KeyNameInformation(3)/KeyCachedInformation(4)/KeyHandleTagsInformation(7); STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL when length insufficient; result_length written before size check. Matches kernel observable contract.

Kernel: entry_count>0x10000 → RtlRaiseStatus(STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES). Sogen: returns STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES directly (same observable status). Per-entry DataOffset/DataLength/Type written on success; buffer_length updated with bytes written. Matches.

Kernel: class>4 → STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER; calls CmQueryValueKeyCallout. Sogen handles KeyValueBasicInformation(0)/KeyValueFullInformation(1)/KeyValuePartialInformation(2); result_length written before data; STATUS_BUFFER_OVERFLOW when too small (partial header still written if space). Observable contract matches.

Kernel: class 5 (KeySetHandleTagsInformation) requires exactly 4 bytes and writes the ULONG to kcb+50 (*((_WORD*)v7+25)). Sogen: requires length==sizeof(KEY_HANDLE_TAGS_INFORMATION)==4, stores info.HandleTags into key->tag as uint16_t. STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH on wrong length; STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE on bad handle. Contract matches.

Kernel: CmObReferenceObjectByHandle(ACCESS_MASK=2) then CmSetValueKey. Sogen: validates handle, reads data from emulator memory (STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION on unreadable pointer), calls registry.set_value. Observable status codes and data-write behavior match.
